summary: On the main deck, as destruction rains around her, Trinity takes hold of Neo's body. Amid the chaos she speaks his name, "Neo...", holding to him while the hull is being torn apart around them.

what_changes.before: Separated from Neo, unable to reach him as the sentinels attack the deck.
what_changes.after: She physically takes hold of him, establishing contact with his body amid the destruction.
what_changes.evidence: Amid the destruction raining around her, Trinity takes hold of Neo's body.

event_hint.one_line: Trinity holds Neo's body on the main deck as the ship is destroyed around them.

uncertain: Whether Neo is truly dead or only appears dead.
Whether Trinity survives the ongoing sentinel attack on the main deck.
